summary.headline: Indegene Q4 FY26 revenue crossed ₹1,000 crore for the first time (+32.8% YoY); FY26 revenue ₹35,105 million, up 23.6% in INR.
summary.overview: Q4 FY26 was the first quarter above ₹1,000 crore revenue, up 6.5% QoQ and 32.8% YoY. Adjusted EBITDA rose 23.2% YoY to ₹1,889 million, but after a ₹241 million forward-contract hedge charge the reported EBITDA was ₹1,648 million. Reported Q4 PAT was ₹797 million after a ₹203 million one-time provision for a 2020 US TCPA class action; management says adjusted PAT grew 12.7% YoY for FY26. Management declined to give formal revenue guidance but said the pipeline is larger and better qualified than at any prior year end.

segments.name: Enterprise Commercial (ex-BioPharm)
segments.commentary: Grew about 17% YoY; BioPharm (acquired October 2025) grew 15% QoQ in Q4. Q4 included a Tectonic engagement with the largest customer for Germany.

segments.name: Enterprise Medical Services (EMS)
segments.commentary: Grew about 16% YoY. Q4 wins included a MedInfo engagement with a biotech, and a GenAI pharmacovigilance win with a medical devices client using NAEM.

segments.name: Geography
segments.commentary: North America 71.6%, Europe 25.5%, Rest of World 2.9%; North America rose about 2 points on BioPharm, which is entirely US-focused.

guidance_outlook: No formal revenue guidance; management said the pipeline entering FY27 is stronger, more balanced and better qualified than any prior year end.
Management expects profitability and EBITDA margins to improve in FY27, with the second half of FY27 reverting to earlier higher margin levels as the ~150 bps investment drag is absorbed.
Margins are expected to stay within the historical range; any leverage above that will be reinvested.
PAT in FY27 expected to rise significantly, helped by higher interest income on cash, amortization stabilizing in the latter half of FY27, and fading one-offs.
The $10 million+ ACV omnichannel deal signed in Q3 has started but will be fully recognized in FY27 because of outcome-based pricing.
Tectonic is expected to become a material growth driver for enterprise commercial in FY27; the largest customer is targeted to cross $50 million.
BioPharm G&A synergies expected to show from the next quarter, with data subscription and go-to-market synergies phasing in through FY27.
Final dividend proposed at ₹2.25 per share, up from ₹2 (12.5%), subject to AGM approval.
capex_capacity: R&D spend rose to slightly above 2% of revenue in FY26, with GTM and domain-expertise investments continuing.
Integration of BioPharm completed ahead of schedule in late February 2026; transition services from the seller were originally planned to end in March.
Global innovation center pilot for a large US biotech and an Agency-of-record pilot (3 months to 3 days) are in early stages, with conversion to engagements targeted within FY27.
Five next-generation operating models are being run in market: One-Click submissions, human-less medical legal review, agentic AOR, AI-embedded engagement, and intelligent R&D operations.
demand_pricing: Active customers rose from 73 to 91; customers above $1 million grew from 41 to 53 (about 30%), and several have scaled to $5 million ACV.
Top 20 customer revenue rose from ₹22,082 million to ₹25,200 million in FY26. A third account crossed $25 million, and the largest customer is in an early phase of a Germany Tectonic engagement.

Q4 bookings: one $3 million+ ACV clinical deal with a new customer; seven $1 million+ ACV deals, four from top 20 customers; one expansion of an omnichannel project; two new engagements (a biotech MedInfo deal and an upcoming pharma launch).
Revenue per employee about $75,000 in FY26, up from $66,000-67,000 a year earlier and $56,000 three years back.
Management says the pricing model is predominantly managed-outcome and output-based rather than timesheet-based, and it sees Indegene as taking share from agencies and CROs.
Constant-currency organic growth was 12% YoY and a little over 3% QoQ, per the CFO in response to a question.
DSO fell to 63 days from 72 days; guidance is mid-60s to 70 days on a steady basis.

qa_highlights.question: Why has the number of $10 million+ clients stayed at 10, and is there a product life cycle issue for large clients?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the cohort is stable, with one client at $9.9 million placed in the lower bucket. Some large clients are taking longer to change operating models, but management expects the cohort to grow.

qa_highlights.question: How defensible is the domain-knowledge moat against LLM commoditization?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the moat is domain expertise plus proprietary data, with multiple frontier models and specialist AI partners orchestrated together. It said LLMs are not reliable enough for regulated operating-grade work over the next 3 to 5 years, so human-in-the-loop remains necessary.

qa_highlights.question: What is the risk that AI investment keeps margins from recovering?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said margins are expected to recover within a few quarters because investments are absorbed, and that it will reinvest any excess above the current margin range rather than expand margins beyond it.

qa_highlights.question: What is Cortex, and is the AI in-house or a wrapper?
qa_highlights.answer: Cortex is a knowledge engineering platform for building agentic workflows for life sciences with enterprise security. It sits on frontier models plus specialist AI such as computer vision and large action models, with the domain layer decoupled from the technology layer.

qa_highlights.question: What are the FY27 growth drivers and what would be different?
qa_highlights.answer: Management described FY27 as a year of scaling FY26 initiatives, pointing to Tectonic with two customers in long-term engagements, the $10 million deal converting in FY27, and consistent $1 million+ wins.

qa_highlights.question: Is there a strategy for small and mid-size pharma and generics?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it is expanding rapidly in mid-size and small companies, with launch models for small biotechs. Generics contribute some revenue, but innovator pharma is prioritised because of the $100 million client opportunity.

qa_highlights.question: What was the constant-currency organic growth in Q4?
qa_highlights.answer: The CFO said 12% YoY organic in constant currency and a little over 3% QoQ.

qa_highlights.question: What is the margin outlook after integrating BioPharm?
qa_highlights.answer: The CFO said integration finished ahead of schedule in late February, with G&A synergies expected from the next quarter and data, operations and GTM synergies phasing in through FY27.

risks_watch: The ₹241 million hedge charge and the forward-contract cash flow hedge accounting change make Q4 EBITDA comparisons harder; adjusted and reported figures differ.
The US TCPA class action settlement is pending court approval (₹203 million provision); management says no further fax-related exposures exist.
Whether the largest customer converts the Germany Tectonic engagement into broader multi-region revenue in FY27, and the $50 million+ milestone.
Whether the $10 million outcome-based deal recognises revenue on schedule in FY27.
Margin recovery in 2H FY27 depends on absorbing the ~150 bps investment; reinvestment is expected.
Interest income and amortization effects from acquisitions on PAT; the CFO expects both to improve in FY27.
The low-visibility AI pilots (Agency-of-record, global innovation centre) have not yet converted to engagements.
summary.management_tone: Confident and forward-leaning, especially on AI differentiation and FY27 pipeline, though management explicitly declined formal revenue guidance and framed margin expansion conservatively. The CFO was precise on adjustments and one-offs, but pushed a PAT recovery story heavily on adjusted figures.
key_quotes: Q4 FY26 was the first ever quarter in our history where our revenues exceeded ₹1,000 crores.
Indegene is not an IT services company that happens to serve life sciences.
GenAI equalizes access to technology. It does not equal access to knowledge.
I want to be direct, we're not providing formal revenue guidance.

growth.why: No formal revenue guidance; management points to a larger, better-qualified pipeline, a $10m+ ACV omnichannel deal to be fully recognised in FY27, and Tectonic as a growth driver, with margin recovery pushed to H2 FY27, but no capacity additions or quantified FY27 revenue target were given.
